item: Cash, equipment quotations and funding milestones
period: At 27 November 2026 and each proposed equipment payment date
why: Current resources and supplier financing capacity are unknown.
conclusion: How much cash Cedar needs before equipment can be commissioned and when a round must close.
action: Stress the forecast with equipment lead times and test downside cash requirements.

item: Repeat multi-shift production and reject logs
period: Representative shifts and lots at the intended staffing and line speed
why: The one-shift trial does not establish sustainable throughput or yield.
conclusion: How many saleable units Cedar can promise per month and whether the line is ready for larger orders.
action: Compare good units, downtime and rework under representative production conditions.

item: Invoices, paid status and collections from the pilot
period: From the pilot order through acceptance, invoicing and collection
why: There is no reconciliation between trial work and recognised commercial activity.
conclusion: Whether the trial generated revenue or secured a paid commercial order.
action: Verify acceptance obligations, billing dates and actual collection.

item: Dated legal entity registration and issued securities
why: The company brief gives the name but ownership and issued shares are unconfirmed.
conclusion: Which entity can issue shares and who would be diluted by the round.
action: Reconcile company registry, securities register and proposed issuer.
